sources.title: Coding a Cricket Brain: The Reality of Building AI from Scra
sources.snippet: Something focused. Something personal. I decided to build a Small Language Model (SLM) from scratch, tailored specifically for the 2023 Cricket World Cup. It sounded simple at first. It wasn’t.

sources.title: Commentary-AI | By Swastik Mishra - commudle.com
sources.snippet: Our project, Commentary.AI, is designed to transform how people experience live sports by using AI to generate real-time, immersive cricket commentary. The goal is to make match viewing more engaging, accessible, and interactive—especially for users who may not have access to traditional commentary or want a more personalized experience.
